BiblicalUsage: Habaiah means Jehovah has hidden. His children are named among the priests who came back from exile, in Ezra's list and again in Nehemiah's, a family whose name means God hid them — and kept them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God hides His priests sometimes, and hiding is not the same as forgetting.
